## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r}
1 + 1
```

You can add options to executable code like this

```{r}
#| echo: false
2 * 2
```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(data.table)
library(tidyverse)
csv_files<-list.files(path = "/Users/samuelking/Downloads/Sogndal_TOMS_Data", pattern = "*.csv", full.names = TRUE)

combined_data <- rbindlist(lapply(csv_files, function(file) {fread(file)[, source_file := basename(file)]}))

combined_data <- combined_data %>% 
  separate(V2, into = c("date", "time"), sep = " ")

combined_data <- combined_data %>%mutate(date = as.Date(date, format = "%Y.%m.%d"))

filtered_data <- combined_data %>% filter(date >= as.Date("2023-04-01"))

filtered_data<- filtered_data %>% rename (Temp_1 = V4, Temp_2 = V5, Temp_3 = V6)

filtered_data<- filtered_data %>% select(-V1)

filtered_data$source_file<- sub("data_", "", filtered_data$source_file)

filtered_data$source_file<- sub(".csv", "", filtered_data$source_file)

filtered_data$source_file<- sub("_2025_05_22_0", "", filtered_data$source_file)

filtered_data<- filtered_data %>% rename (Logger_ID = source_file)

further_consolidated<-filtered_data %>% select(-V9)

further_consolidated<-further_consolidated %>% select(-V10)

further_consolidated<-further_consolidated %>% select(-V3)

further_consolidated<-further_consolidated %>% select(-V8)
```
